# Red/Blue Gym Leaders & Elite Four

The standard Pokémon format as initialised here in Red/Blue is to battle your way through 8 gyms, each specializing in a particular type. Following that you take on the Elite Four and the Champion.

### Gym Leaders

1.   Brock(Pewter City)
2.   Misty(Cerulean City)
3.   Lt. Surge(Vermilion City)
4.   Erika(Celadon City)
5.   Koga(Fuchsia City)
6.   Sabrina(Saffron City)
7.   Blaine(Cinnabar Island)
8.   Giovanni(Viridian City)

### Elite Four

1.   Lorelei
2.   Bruno
3.   Agatha
4.   Lance
5.   Blue

# Red/Blue Gym Leaders & Elite Four

The standard Pokémon format as initialised here in Red/Blue is to battle your way through 8 gyms, each specializing in a particular type. Following that you take on the Elite Four and the Champion.

### Gym Leaders

1.   Brock(Pewter City)
2.   Misty(Cerulean City)
3.   Lt. Surge(Vermilion City)
4.   Erika(Celadon City)
5.   Koga(Fuchsia City)
6.   Sabrina(Saffron City)
7.   Blaine(Cinnabar Island)
8.   Giovanni(Viridian City)

### Elite Four

1.   Lorelei
2.   Bruno
3.   Agatha
4.   Lance
5.   Blue

## Effects

_Psychic_ deals damage and has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Special Defense by one stage.

Stats can be lowered to a minimum of -6 stages each.

### Changes

*   In Generation 1, _Psychic_ has a 30% chance of lowering the target's Special stat (Sp.Atk and Sp.Def combined).  

### Z-Move effects

When a Pokémon is holding [Psychium Z](https://pokemondb.net/item/psychium-z) and uses its Z-Power, _Psychic_ turns into [Shattered Psyche](https://pokemondb.net/move/shattered-psyche) and has base power **175**.

When Mew is holding [Mewnium Z](https://pokemondb.net/item/mewnium-z) and uses its Z-Power, _Psychic_ turns into [Genesis Supernova](https://pokemondb.net/move/genesis-supernova) and has base power **185**.

## Effects

_Psychic_ deals damage and has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Special Defense by one stage.

Stats can be lowered to a minimum of -6 stages each.

### Changes

*   In Generation 1, _Psychic_ has a 30% chance of lowering the target's Special stat (Sp.Atk and Sp.Def combined).  

### Z-Move effects

When a Pokémon is holding [Psychium Z](https://pokemondb.net/item/psychium-z) and uses its Z-Power, _Psychic_ turns into [Shattered Psyche](https://pokemondb.net/move/shattered-psyche) and has base power **175**.

When Mew is holding [Mewnium Z](https://pokemondb.net/item/mewnium-z) and uses its Z-Power, _Psychic_ turns into [Genesis Supernova](https://pokemondb.net/move/genesis-supernova) and has base power **185**.

_Slowbro_ is a [Water](https://pokemondb.net/type/water)/[Psychic](https://pokemondb.net/type/psychic) type Pokémon introduced in Generation 1.

_Slowbro_ has a Mega Evolution, available in Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire and [Pokémon Go](https://pokemondb.net/go), and a Galarian Form, introduced in the [Pokémon Sword/Shield](https://pokemondb.net/sword-shield) Expansion Pass.

# Kadabra - Generation 1 learnset

This page lists all the moves that Kadabra can learn in Generation 1, which consists of these games:

*   Pokémon Red
*   Pokémon Blue
*   Pokémon Yellow

Note: many moves have changed stats over the years. The power, accuracy and other information listed below is as it was in the respective games. Check a move's detail page for stats in the most recent games and when they changed.
